data.exact_reserve_text: Overall on an aggregate basis, reserve releases of GBP 2.6m (2013: GBP 0.7m) net of reinsurance were made from prior year reserves. The reserve release in 2014 was generated by the Fire and other damage to property and Reinsurance segments.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2014 was GBP 64.958m. The report states that on an aggregate basis there were reserve releases net of reinsurance of GBP 2.6m in 2014 (2013: GBP 0.7m), generated by the Fire and other damage to property and Reinsurance segments. No gross prior-year movement figure is provided, so the reported net release has been used as a fallback.
raw_causal_phrases: Overall on an aggregate basis, reserve releases of GBP 2.6m (2013: GBP 0.7m) net of reinsurance were made from prior year reserves.
The reserve release in 2014 was generated by the Fire and other damage to property and Reinsurance segments.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year reserve movement (gross claims outstanding movement) not provided in the notes; only a net-of-reinsurance reserve release of GBP 2.6m is stated and has been used as a fallback. Some small table values (e.g. 'Energy - Marine' listed as 3 in the scanned table) were read from the image and are of low magnitude; values are taken from the Segmental Analysis (page 19) and Balance Sheet (page 14) which report amounts in GBP 79'000 units (reported here in millions).
